translations.web: The priest shall make atonement for him before Yahweh, and he will be forgiven concerning whatever he does to become guilty.”
translations.bsb: In this way the priest will make atonement for him before the LORD, and he will be forgiven for anything he may have done to incur guilt.”
translations.kjv: And the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD: and it shall be forgiven him for any thing of all that he hath done in trespassing
translations.asv: and the priest shall make atonement for him before Jehovah; and he shall be forgiven concerning whatsoever he doeth so as to be guilty thereby.
